ways.label: Round trip via Pillar Point Lighthouse Track and Wharariki Road

start.name: Triangle Flat car park
start.quote: the car park at Triangle Flat

end.name: Triangle Flat car park
end.quote: the car park at Triangle Flat

evidence: For a round trip, continue on the Pillar Point Lighthouse Track (a 4WD track) to Wharariki Road (30 min) and return to the car park via Wharariki Road (1 hr).

doubts: Main way end: the text says the full track runs to Wharariki Beach and ends at the end of Wharariki Road (pickup point); F3 chosen as the end. Locations of the Pillar Point Lighthouse and Cape Farewell car parks are not certain (F4 is where the lighthouse track meets Wharariki Road, which is not necessarily the lighthouse car park), so refs are null. The page also says one can return via the same track (or by Wharariki Road) or arrange pick-up, so walking back is an exit, not a way. Wharariki Beach Track link L1 may be the same as the map track but not given as a ref for the via.
